content: NSPasteboard exposes ownership changes through changeCount and supports multiple typed representations per item. X11 selections are asynchronous and owner-based; freedesktop guidance distinguishes explicit-copy CLIPBOARD from selection-driven PRIMARY and recommends CLIPBOARD for Mac-like cut, copy, and paste behavior. The prototype should synchronize only CLIPBOARD, preserve plain UTF-8 and HTML representations, bound total bytes, suppress echoes with origin and sequence metadata, and leave both local clipboards unchanged on unsupported or oversize payloads. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nspasteboard, https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nspasteboard/changecount, https://specifications.freedesktop.org/clipboard/latest/, and https://www.x.org/releases/current/doc/xorg-docs/icccm/icccm.pdf.
